## Description

Trains one or more agents to split a large order over time while trading off market impact, price risk, inventory and execution completion.

## Where it may fit

Large institutional orders where execution schedule and market impact matter more than predicting long-run direction.

## Vehicles

Execution desks, buy-side transition management, multi-agent execution research.

## Required data

Order-book or high-frequency price/volume data, order size/deadline, market impact model, inventory state, fees and realistic fill simulation.

## Caveats

A simulator can be exploited by the agent; validate against TWAP/VWAP/Almgren-Chriss and test realistic queue/impact dynamics.
